question.prompt: \(f(x)=2x+1\). What is the average rate of change from \(x=0\) to \(x=4\)?

solutions.explanation: The average rate of change of a linear function is its slope, 2.
solutions.title: Read the linear slope

solutions.explanation:
The average rate of change is the change in function value divided by the change in input. Thus
\[
\frac{f(4)-f(0)}{4-0}=\frac{9-1}{4}=2.
\]
solutions.title: Compute endpoint differences
